README.md:
# Your lab

Review plan.json and the Ansible roles before applying.
Publish this repository at the Git URL in the plan before applying Argo CD.
Run bromigos lab provision apply --repo <this-folder> to converge again.
Removing a service from the selection leaves its data and running resources in place.
ansible/ansible.cfg:
[defaults]
roles_path = roles
host_key_checking = True
retry_files_enabled = False
ansible/roles/announce/files/bromigos-la:
<?xml version="1.0" standalone="no"?>
<!DOCTYPE service-group SYSTEM "avahi-service.dtd">
<!-- bromigos lab provision: so Find my lab (bromigos setup homelab, its find option) finds this box -->
<service-group>
  <name replace-wildcards="yes">bromigOS lab on %h</name>
  <service>
    <type>_bromigos-lab._tcp</type>
    <port>22</port>
    <txt-record>txtvers=1</txt-record>
  </service>
</service-group>
